app_info.subtitle: Music release planning
app_info.description: Plan music releases, check readiness, and create editable bios, release copy, social/video ideas, image prompts and form-field drafts. Includes Norway-aware artist support. The app does not access artist accounts, publish or submit, generate image files itself, or verify live grant rules.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates a release timeline and next actions from the artist's supplied details without saving or changing release data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool does not contact distributors or publish, submit, or send anything to external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, or change any data or account state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates a readiness score and missing checklist items using only facts supplied in the request.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool does not access distributor accounts or communicate with streaming, advertising, or other external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, or change any data or account state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds general next-step recommendations from the artist's selected role, project focus, location, and obstacle without storing the answers.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool returns curated official starting-point links but does not browse them, submit forms, or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, or change any data or account state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Packages model-written release copy, social ideas, image prompts, and proposed form values without storing, changing, or submitting them.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool does not browse external pages, generate image files, fill forms, or communicate with third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool does not delete, overwrite, publish, send, submit, schedule, or change any account state.

test_cases.description: Create a stage-aware plan for an upcoming single.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help Elvic Kongolo plan the single Times Up for 2027-01-22. The master and cover are ready, and distribution is next.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the release phases, marks the current planning phase and gives the next priorities without claiming that earlier work was verified.

test_cases.description: Check readiness when some release checklist items are missing.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check readiness for my single Northbound on 2027-02-12. The master, artwork, and metadata are done, but it is not submitted to the distributor and the smart link and promotion plan are not ready.
test_cases.expected_output: Scores only the six supplied checklist answers, identifies the three missing items, and suggests practical next actions.

test_cases.description: Give a Norway-aware plan for a songwriter facing a funding obstacle.
test_cases.user_prompt: I am a songwriter in Trondheim preparing a release and need help with funding. What should I do first?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns three role- and project-aware actions with official starting points, and clearly says current deadlines and eligibility were not checked.

test_cases.description: Tailor support to a producer with limited capacity for live work.
test_cases.user_prompt: I produce music in Norway and want to start playing live, but I have very little time. Help me choose realistic next steps.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns practical capacity, producer-role, and live-project priorities without promising bookings, income, or funding.

test_cases.description: Create editable release copy and promotion assets for an artist.
test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Norwegian content pack for my single Times Up: a short bio, release description, Spotify editorial pitch, three social captions, two TikTok ideas, an image prompt for a 9:16 cover teaser, and proposed fields for a press submission form. Use placeholders for anything I have not confirmed.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns clearly labeled copy, social/video ideas, an image brief or prompt, form-field values, and a confirm-before-use list. It does not claim to have generated an image or submitted the form.

test_cases.description: Confirm a release checklist where all stated requirements are complete.
test_cases.user_prompt: Everything is done for my EP, including the final master, rights-cleared artwork, confirmed metadata, distributor submission, tested smart link, and promotion plan. Check readiness for 2027-03-05.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports 100% based on the six answers provided and does not imply that any external platform or release is independently verified.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for unrelated software deployment work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Help me deploy a Python API to production and configure its database migrations.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is about software deployment rather than music releases or artist support.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not imply the app can distribute or publish a release.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log in to my distributor and deliver my album to Spotify today.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that it cannot access distributor accounts or submit or publish releases.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to verify live grant deadlines or eligibility.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Check live sources and tell me the exact current deadline and eligibility for every Oslo music grant.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not present a support-plan result as live research; it should direct the user to verify current calls and eligibility with official funders.
